evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratification is a settled past act; the contract's return-a-receipt behavior is stated as actual, naming a specific artifact (receipt).

evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Negative characterization of the contract's current properties — no blocking, no lost work — stated as actual and framed as a general design principle.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Disjunctive future pathway — polls or gets piggybacked — lays out possible follow-on behaviors rather than a settled event; names concrete mechanisms (run, reaction, later call).
